card.name: Opening bracket before abbreviations or intervals
card.fires_on: The opening square bracket (sometimes with a parenthesis) that comes right after a term and introduces an abbreviation, a confidence interval or a cross-reference. It is common after hazard ratios and after phrases like major molecular response.

modes.label: Confidence interval bracket
modes.description: A bracket opens after a hazard ratio value and begins the 95% CI.

modes.label: Abbreviation or reference bracket
modes.description: A bracket and parenthesis open after a full term to give its abbreviation or a see-section reference.
